beats.say: How do we add one third and one quarter?
Adding the tops and the bottoms gives two sevenths. But two sevenths is smaller than one third on its own, so that can't be right.
Here is one third and one quarter. The shaded pieces are different sizes, so we can't count them together yet.
Cut both into the same size pieces: cut the third into 4 rows and the quarter into 3 columns.
Now each whole has 3 times 4 = 12 equal pieces. One third is 4 twelfths, and one quarter is 3 twelfths.
The pieces match, so put them together: 4 twelfths and 3 twelfths make 7 twelfths. one third + one quarter = seven twelfths.
Remember: make the pieces the same size first, then add the tops. The bottom stays the same.
